capabilities: Sync vault documents and files through the NAVER memo service
Run sync periodically and after a period of inactivity following the last edit
Log in to NAVER and start sync from the command palette
extras: README warns that sync may fail due to unclear NAVER storage policies, uses Last Write Wins conflict resolution, synchronizes external deletions, and advises backing up files first; reports issues via GitHub Issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized across devices through NAVER's memo service.

relations.evidence: This plugin synchronizes documents and files in Obsidian using Naver's memo service.

summary: Vault sync plugin that uses NAVER's memo service as storage for cross-device synchronization of notes and files, including on mobile.
